salient_findings: Hypoechogenic subcardial mass on the posterior gastric wall
Recurrent bleeding tumour at the same site after resection
key_facts: 48-year-old woman
7-year history of submucosal tumour
Tumour located below the esophagogastric junction
Presented with melena and progressive anemia
Hemoglobin level was 7.5 g/dL
Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen revealed a 70 × 50 × 55 mm hypoechogenic mass
Lesion was resected endoscopically by a piecemeal technique under general anesthesia
Histopathology reportedly confirmed a lipoma
Recurrent bleeding tumour at the same site six weeks after resection

differentials: Intra-abdominal desmoplastic small round cell tumor
per_call: Intra-abdominal desmoplastic small round cell tumor

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent bleeding submucosal gastric tumour with significant size and rapid recurrence

shortlist.label: Liposarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Initial histopathology confirmed a lipoma, but rapid recurrence raises concern for malignant transformation

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Submucosal location and significant size of the tumour are consistent with leiomyosarcoma

shortlist.label: Gastric adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Although less likely, gastric adenocarcinoma can present as a submucosal mass and should be considered

shortlist.label: Carcinoid tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Neuroendocrine features and submucosal location make carcinoid tumor a plausible, albeit less common, diagnosis

raw.rationale: The tumour's location below the esophagogastric junction, its submucosal nature, and its tendency to bleed and recur after resection are more consistent with a gastrointestinal stromal tumor than a lipoma, especially given the large size and aggressive behavior

rejected.label: Liposarcoma
rejected.why: Liposarcomas are rare in the gastrointestinal tract and the initial diagnosis of lipoma is likely incorrect given the tumour's aggressive behavior

rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: While leiomyosarcomas can occur in the gastrointestinal tract, the description is more consistent with a gastrointestinal stromal tumor

rejected.label: Gastric adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: Gastric adenocarcinoma typically presents with different symptoms and does not usually present as a submucosal tumour with these characteristics

rejected.label: Carcinoid tumor
rejected.why: Carcinoid tumors are typically smaller and less aggressive than the tumour described

rejected.label: Lipoma
rejected.why: The initial diagnosis of lipoma is likely incorrect given the tumour's large size, aggressive behavior, and tendency to bleed and recur
